<section class="wrap section" id="about">
  <div class="cols">
    <h2>About Me</h2>
    <div class="prose">
      <p>Thank you for visiting my website!</p>
      <p>I completed a double major in Economics and Statistics at the <a href="https://www.ug.edu.gh/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">University of Ghana</a> with First Class Honours (GPA 3.91/4.00), graduating in the top 1% of my class as Overall Best Student in both Statistics and Economics. My interests lie in statistical methodology and quantitative research, with applications in health, economics, and public policy.</p>
      <p>In statistics, my research examines structural brain changes associated with Alzheimer&rsquo;s disease using longitudinal MRI data and statistical learning. In economics, I studied the design and implementation of Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS) and the role of census questionnaires in evidence-based policymaking. These experiences have deepened my interest in applying rigorous statistical methods to real-world problems through graduate study.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
